changelog: 5.9.28 (Build 5928): NEW update popup - when a newer RubyOS is out, RubyOS shows a notification: 'New update available: RubyOS 5.9.28' with Yes / No buttons. Yes starts the update right away; No dismisses it and that version will not nag you again (a newer one still will). Update checking is now FAST: instead of a fixed 60-second wait, RubyOS runs its real checks - core functions, screen pieces, built-in app files, every app, the update server - and finishes as soon as they all pass, about 3 seconds. The red roadblock screen and automatic fallback to your last working version after 3 failed attempts still protect you.
Ruby AI stays off until its API key is ready. Everything else is unchanged.
